# Kurnia Alim
## Kurnia Alim
### Title
**Kurnia Alim** is an industrial designer who has been working with Mattel since at least 2012. He has worked on various tracks and playsets and is the current lead designer of the Hot Wheels Monster Trucks line, taking over from Brendon Vetuskey . Prior to working at Mattel he worked at Jakks Pacific.
